title: DemonsTTRate: A Global, Observational, Multicenter, Long-term Study of Patients With ATTR-CM in a Real-World Setting
official: DemonsTTRate: A Global, Observational, Multicenter, Long-term Study of Patients With Transthyretin-Mediated Amyloidosis With Cardiomyopathy in a Real-World Setting
summary:
The purpose of this study is to:

* Describe the clinical characteristics of adult patients with transthyretin-mediated amyloidosis with cardiomyopathy (ATTR-CM) treated with vutrisiran in routine clinical care
* Describe treatment patterns of adult patients with ATTR-CM treated with vutrisiran in routine clinical care
* Assess health-related quality of life (HRQOL) in adult patients with ATTR-CM treated with vutrisiran in routine clinical care
* Assess healthcare resource use (HCRU) in adult patients with ATTR-CM treated with vutrisiran in routine clinical care
* Compare the long-term effectiveness of vutrisiran versus other approved ATTR-CM treatments in routine clinical care
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Has a diagnosis of ATTR-CM
* Is initiating treatment with vutrisiran or another approved ATTR-CM therapy

Exclusion Criteria:

* Is enrolled in an interventional clinical trial
